'GeometricTrace.projection_after_convolution' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
GeometricTrace.projection_after_convolution.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H] (M : Submodule ℂ H) [CompleteSpace ↥M] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : ∀ x ∈ M, A x ∈ M) :
  (GeometricTrace.spec M).comp A = ((GeometricTrace.spec M).comp A).comp (GeometricTrace.spec M)
